segments.name: Monster Energy® Drinks
segments.description: Develops and sells ready-to-drink energy drinks to bottlers, distributors and retail customers.
segments.evidence: Monster Energy® Drinks segment ("Monster Energy® Drinks"), which is primarily comprised of our Monster Energy® drinks, Reign Total Body Fuel® high performance energy drinks, Reign Storm® total wellness energy drinks and Bang Energy® drinks

segments.name: Strategic Brands
segments.description: Sells concentrates and beverage bases for energy drink brands acquired from TCCC, plus affordable energy brands, to authorized bottlers.
segments.evidence: Strategic Brands segment ("Strategic Brands"), which is primarily comprised of the various energy drink brands acquired from The Coca-Cola Company ("TCCC") in 2015 as well as our affordable energy brands, Predator® and Fury®

segments.name: Alcohol Brands
segments.description: Sells craft beers, flavored malt beverages and hard seltzers primarily to beer distributors in the United States.
segments.evidence: Alcohol Brands segment ("Alcohol Brands"), which is comprised of various craft beers, FMBs and hard seltzers

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Comprises AFF products sold to independent third-party customers.
segments.evidence: Other segment ("Other"), which is comprised of certain products sold by American Fruits and Flavors LLC ("AFF"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, to independent third-party customers (the "AFF Third-Party Products")

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling ready-to-drink packaged drinks to bottlers/distributors and retailers, concentrates and beverage bases to authorized bottlers, and beers and hard seltzers to beer distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's Monster Energy® Drinks segment primarily generates net operating revenues by selling ready-to-drink packaged drinks primarily to bottlers/distributors.

changes.text: In 2022, the company acquired Monster Brewing Company, entering the alcohol beverage sector.
changes.evidence: In 2022, we completed our acquisition of Monster Brewing Company, which facilitated our entry into the alcohol beverage sector.

changes.text: In 2023, the company acquired the Bang Energy® drink business.
changes.evidence: In 2023, we completed our acquisition of the Bang Energy® drink business.
